In this vlog, we share a difficult situation we recently faced. We tried to help a woman in need by offering her a job and sending Sonu all the way to Raxaul to bring her safely to our home. However, after a 12-hour journey and significant struggle, the situation took an unexpected turn.

Watch as we explain the details of the struggle Sonu went through, the rude behavior we encountered from the woman's family, and the eventual apology. We also share an important warning regarding respect and boundaries for our family and home. We believe in helping others, but it's important to stand up against unfair treatment.
